name: Consul
description: Consul is a service discovery and configuration tool developed by HashiCorp. It provides a distributed, highly available, and datacenter-aware solution for service discovery, configuration, and orchestration. Consul features include service discovery via DNS or HTTP interface, health checking of services and nodes, key/value storage for configuration, and multi-datacenter support. It enables microservices architectures by providing service mesh capabilities, distributed configuration management, and automatic failover mechanisms.

notes.text: Default configuration sets up a single-node cluster in development mode
Web UI accessible at port 8500, DNS interface at port 8600
For production use, configure proper ACLs and TLS encryption
Default datacenter name is 'dc1', can be changed in configuration
